mission: Aidel Saxan defies Alliance pressure in a public Corellian policy address while private political chess moves behind her.
why_now: The Alliance's ultimatum on Corellian disarmament expires within the week; Saxan is answering publicly.
opening_hook: Saxan at a podium on the Corellian Parliament floor, the camera drones tracking her entry.
conflict: Saxan's legitimate leadership of Corellian sovereignty against Dur Gejjen's backroom readiness to replace her if she overreaches.
turning_point: Saxan explicitly names Corellia's right to refuse Alliance garrisoning — the line across which the Alliance will move.
closing_hook: Gejjen in a back corridor nodding once to an aide after her speech.
setting: Corellian Parliament address chamber, Coronet City; afternoon.
sensory_details: Corellian chamber's warmer wood tones; the faint applause of a sympathetic chamber; Saxan's silver pin.
emotional_trajectory: Controlled public address → private political calculation → sharpened line.

stakes.personal: Saxan's political survival as Prime Minister.
stakes.interpersonal: Saxan/Gejjen's informal alliance as it frays.
stakes.external: Corellia's formal posture toward the Alliance.

canon_elements_needed: Aidel Saxan as Corellian Prime Minister
action_beats: Gejjen watches from a back corridor
notes: Saxan's sympathetic register established so her death in Ch 13 lands.
